title: Asking Someone to Repeat
situation: A learner at a clinic desk misses the appointment time and politely asks the staff member to repeat it.
somali_situation: Arday jooga miiska rug caafimaad ayaa seegaya waqtiga ballanta wuxuuna si xushmad leh u codsanayaa in lagu celiyo.
key_phrases: I missed part of what you said.
Could you say it again more slowly?
Of course. I said the appointment is at ten thirty, not eleven.
Did you say ten thirty?
Yes, ten thirty.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Sorry, I missed part of what you said.
dialogue.somali: Waan ka xumahay, qayb ka mid ah hadalkaaga waan seegay.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: That's okay. The appointment is at ten thirty.
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Ballantu waa tobanka iyo bar.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Could you say it again more slowly?
dialogue.somali: Si tartiib ah mar kale ma u oran kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Of course. I said the appointment is at ten thirty, not eleven.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Waxaan iri ballantu waa tobanka iyo bar, ma aha kow iyo tobanka.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Did you say ten thirty?
dialogue.somali: Ma waxaad tiri tobanka iyo bar?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Yes, ten thirty.
dialogue.somali: Haa, tobanka iyo bar.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Thank you. I am listening carefully now.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Hadda si taxaddar leh ayaan u dhageysanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: No problem. Please come ten minutes early.
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Fadlan toban daqiiqo hore u imow.

title: Asking Someone to Speak Slowly
situation: A learner at a bus ticket desk asks the staff member to speak slowly while explaining the route.
somali_situation: Arday jooga miiska tigidhada baska ayaa shaqaalaha ka codsanaya inuu si tartiib ah u hadlo marka uu sharxayo jidka.
key_phrases: Could you speak slowly, please?
I am still learning English.
Take the number 12 bus.
Do I need to change buses?
Thank you. That is clear now.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Excuse me. Could you speak slowly, please?
dialogue.somali: Iga raalli noqo. Si tartiib ah ma u hadli kartaa, fadlan?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Of course. I will give you the instructions slowly.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Tilmaamaha si tartiib ah ayaan kuu siinayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Thank you. I am still learning English.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Weli Ingiriis ayaan baranayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: No problem. Take the number 12 bus.
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Raac baska lambarkiisu yahay 12.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Do I need to change buses?
dialogue.somali: Ma u baahanahay inaan bas kale u wareego?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Yes. Change at the main station.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Ka beddel saldhigga weyn.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Can you say the station name again?
dialogue.somali: Magaca saldhigga mar kale ma sheegi kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Main Station. It is written on your bus ticket.
dialogue.somali: Saldhigga weyn. Wuxuu ku qoran yahay tigidhkaaga baska.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Thank you. That is clear now.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Hadda way ii caddahay.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: You're welcome. Listen for the driver to call the stop.
dialogue.somali: Adaa mudan. Dhageyso marka darawalku joogsiga sheego.

title: Asking What a Word Means
situation: A learner at a library asks what the word 'renew' means on a computer screen.
somali_situation: Arday jooga maktabad ayaa weydiinaya macnaha erayga 'renew' oo shaashadda kumbuyuutarka ku qoran.
key_phrases: What does this word mean?
Renew means to borrow the book for more time.
Could you give me an example?
The meaning is clear now.
Can I renew this book today?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Excuse me. What does this word mean?
dialogue.somali: Iga raalli noqo. Eraygan macnihiisu waa maxay?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Which word are you looking at?
dialogue.somali: Eraygee ayaad eegaysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: The word is renew. It is on the library screen.
dialogue.somali: Eraygu waa renew. Wuxuu ku qoran yahay shaashadda maktabadda.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Renew means to borrow the book for more time.
dialogue.somali: Renew macnihiisu waa inaad buugga waqti dheeraad ah sii amaahato.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Could you give me an example?
dialogue.somali: Tusaale ma ii siin kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Yes. If your book is due today, you can renew it for another week.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Haddii buuggaagu maanta dhacayo, toddobaad kale ayaad cusboonaysiin kartaa.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: So it does not mean I must return it today?
dialogue.somali: Markaa macnaheedu ma aha inaan maanta soo celiyo?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Right. It means you can keep it longer.
dialogue.somali: Sax. Waxay ka dhigan tahay inaad sii haysan karto muddo dheer.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: The meaning is clear now.
dialogue.somali: Macnuhu hadda wuu ii caddahay.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Good. Do you want help pressing the button?
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. Ma rabtaa caawin markaad badhanka riixayso?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Yes, please. Can I renew this book today?
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan. Buuggan maanta ma cusboonaysiin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Yes. Click renew, then confirm.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Guji renew, kadibna xaqiiji.

title: Asking for Spelling on the Phone
situation: A learner books a class by phone and asks the staff member to spell the name and confirm an email address.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa telefoon ku qabsanaya fasal wuxuuna shaqaalaha ka codsanayaa in magaca la higgaadiyo lana xaqiijiyo cinwaan email.
key_phrases: Could you spell your name for me?
Is Amina with a capital letter?
Can you spell the email address slowly?
There is a hyphen between the two names, correct?
Could you read it back to me?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Good morning. I would like to book an English class.
dialogue.somali: Subax wanaagsan. Waxaan rabaa inaan qabsado fasal Ingiriisi ah.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Certainly. Could you spell your name for me?
dialogue.somali: Hubaal. Magacaaga ma ii higgaadin kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: It is Amina Yusuf.
dialogue.somali: Waa Amina Yusuf.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Could you spell the family name?
dialogue.somali: Magaca qoyska ma higgaadin kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Y-U-S-U-F.
dialogue.somali: Y-U-S-U-F.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Thank you. Is Amina with a capital letter?
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Amina xaraf weyn ma ku bilaabataa?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Yes, capital A.
dialogue.somali: Haa, A weyn.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Can you spell the email address slowly?
dialogue.somali: Cinwaanka email-ka si tartiib ah ma u higgaadin kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: It is amina-yusuf at mail dot com.
dialogue.somali: Waa amina-yusuf at mail dot com.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: There is a hyphen between the two names, correct?
dialogue.somali: Labada magac dhexdooda hyphen baa ku jira, sax miyaa?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Yes, a hyphen, not an underscore.
dialogue.somali: Haa, hyphen, ma aha underscore.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Could you read it back to me?
dialogue.somali: Ma ii akhrin kartaa si aan u hubiyo?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Amina hyphen Yusuf at mail dot com.
dialogue.somali: Amina hyphen Yusuf at mail dot com.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Yes, that is correct. Thank you for checking the spelling.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa sax. Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad higgaadda hubisay.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: No problem. I will send a confirmation email today.
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Maanta ayaan kuu soo diri doonaa email xaqiijin ah.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Great. I will check my inbox this afternoon.
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. Galabta ayaan sanduuqa email-kayga hubin doonaa.

title: Asking How to Pronounce a Word
situation: A learner asks a staff member how to pronounce the word 'appointment' before speaking at reception.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa shaqaale weydiinaya sida loo dhawaaqo erayga 'appointment' ka hor inta uusan ka hadlin soo-dhoweynta.
key_phrases: How do you pronounce this word?
The word is appointment.
Please say it slowly.
Can I repeat it?
Your pronunciation is good.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Excuse me. How do you pronounce this word?
dialogue.somali: Iga raalli noqo. Eraygan sidee loo dhawaaqaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: The word is appointment.
dialogue.somali: Eraygu waa appointment.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Please say it slowly.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan si tartiib ah u dheh.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Appointment. The stress is on point.
dialogue.somali: Appointment. Culayska dhawaaqu wuxuu saaran yahay point.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Can I repeat it?
dialogue.somali: Ma ku celin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Yes, please try.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan isku day.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Appointment.
dialogue.somali: Appointment.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Good. Your pronunciation is good.
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. Dhawaaqaagu wuu fiican yahay.

title: Saying You Do Not Understand
situation: A learner at a pharmacy says they do not understand the medicine instructions and asks for a simpler explanation.
somali_situation: Arday jooga farmashiye ayaa sheegaya inuusan fahmin tilmaamaha daawada wuxuuna codsanayaa sharaxaad ka fudud.
key_phrases: I'm sorry, I do not understand.
Can you explain it in simple words?
Take one dose in the morning and one in the evening.
So I take the medicine twice a day?
Exactly, that is right.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: I'm sorry, I do not understand.
dialogue.somali: Waan ka xumahay, ma fahmin.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: That's okay. Which part is confusing?
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Qaybtee ayaa kugu wareertay?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: The medicine instructions are difficult for me.
dialogue.somali: Tilmaamaha daawadu way igu adag yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: I can help. Take one dose in the morning and one in the evening.
dialogue.somali: Waan ku caawin karaa. Hal qiyaas qaado subaxdii, midna fiidkii.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Can you explain it in simple words?
dialogue.somali: Erayo fudud ma iigu sharxi kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Yes. Take the medicine after breakfast and after dinner.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Daawada qaado quraacda kadib iyo cashada kadib.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: So I take the medicine twice a day?
dialogue.somali: Markaa daawada laba jeer maalintii ayaan qaadanayaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Exactly, that is right.
dialogue.somali: Sidaas ayay tahay, waa sax.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Thank you. I understand now.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Hadda waan fahmay.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: You're welcome. Ask for help if you are unsure.
dialogue.somali: Adaa mudan. Caawimaad weydiiso haddii aadan hubin.

title: Requesting an Interpreter
situation: A patient at a clinic asks for a Somali interpreter before discussing health information.
somali_situation: Bukaan jooga rug caafimaad ayaa codsanaya turjubaan Soomaali ah ka hor inta aan xog caafimaad laga wada hadlin.
key_phrases: Could I have a Somali interpreter?
I want to understand before I give consent.
The interpreter will join by phone.
Will the conversation be private?
Please wait in the clinic room on the left.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Hello. Could I have a Somali interpreter?
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Turjubaan Soomaali ah ma heli karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Yes. Is this for your clinic appointment today?
dialogue.somali: Haa. Ma ballantaada rugta caafimaad ee maanta baa?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Yes. I understand some English, but health words are difficult.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Ingiriis xoogaa waan fahmaa, laakiin erayada caafimaadku way adag yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: That is fine. The interpreter will join by phone.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa hagaag. Turjubaanku telefoon ayuu kaga soo biiri doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: How long will I wait?
dialogue.somali: Intee ayaan sugayaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: About ten minutes.
dialogue.somali: Qiyaastii toban daqiiqo.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Will the conversation be private?
dialogue.somali: Wadahadalku ma qarsoodi buu ahaanayaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Yes, the interpreter keeps your information private.
dialogue.somali: Haa, turjubaanku xogtaada si qarsoodi ah ayuu u haynayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Good. I want to understand before I give consent.
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. Waxaan rabaa inaan fahmo ka hor inta aanan oggolaansho bixin.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Of course. The nurse will wait for the language support.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Kalkaalisadu waxay sugi doontaa taageerada luqadda.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Thank you. Where should I go now?
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Hadda xaggee baan aadaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Please wait in the clinic room on the left.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan ku sug qolka rugta ee bidixda ku yaal.

title: Confirming Appointment Details
situation: A learner confirms appointment details at reception to make sure the date, time, address, and phone number are correct.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa soo-dhoweynta ku xaqiijinaya faahfaahinta ballanta si uu u hubiyo in taariikhda, waqtiga, cinwaanka, iyo lambarka telefoonku sax yihiin.
key_phrases: Can I confirm the appointment details?
The date is Tuesday the fifteenth.
Yes, two forty-five in the afternoon.
Could you check my phone number?
Yes, that is correct.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Before I leave, can I confirm the appointment details?
dialogue.somali: Ka hor intaanan bixin, faahfaahinta ballanta ma xaqiijin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Of course. The date is Tuesday the fifteenth.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Taariikhdu waa Talaado shan iyo tobanka.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Tuesday the fifteenth. And the time is two forty-five?
dialogue.somali: Talaado shan iyo tobanka. Waqtiguna waa laba iyo afartan iyo shan?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Yes, two forty-five in the afternoon.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laba iyo afartan iyo shan galabnimo.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Is the address 20 Green Street?
dialogue.somali: Cinwaanku ma 20 Green Street baa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Almost. It is 20 Green Road, not Green Street.
dialogue.somali: Ku dhow. Waa 20 Green Road, ma aha Green Street.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Thank you for the correction. Green Road.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay sixitaanka. Green Road.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: That's right. Please bring your photo ID.
dialogue.somali: Waa sax. Fadlan keen aqoonsigaaga sawirka leh.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Could you check my phone number?
dialogue.somali: Lambarka telefoonkayga ma hubin kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.somali: Haa. Waxaan hayaa 07710 482 936.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Yes, that is correct.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa sax.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Would you like a text reminder?
dialogue.somali: Ma rabtaa fariin xusuusin ah?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Yes, please send a reminder the day before.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan maalin ka hor xusuusin ii soo dir.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: I will add that now.
dialogue.somali: Hadda ayaan taas ku dari doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Thank you. I have the correct details now.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Hadda faahfaahinta saxda ah waan hayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: You're welcome. We will see you on Tuesday.
dialogue.somali: Adaa mudan. Talaadada ayaan ku arki doonnaa.

title: Asking Someone to Write It Down
situation: A learner asks a staff member to write down an address and phone number so they can read it later.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa shaqaale ka codsanaya inuu qoro cinwaan iyo lambar telefoon si uu mar dambe u akhriyo.
key_phrases: Could you write it down, please?
I'll write the address on this paper.
Can you add the phone number?
I can read it later.
Here is the note.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Sorry, the address is difficult for me.
dialogue.somali: Waan ka xumahay, cinwaanku wuu igu adag yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: No problem. Could you write it down, please?
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Ma qori kartaa, fadlan?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Yes. I'll write the address on this paper.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Cinwaanka waxaan ku qori doonaa warqaddan.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Thank you. Can you add the phone number?
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Lambarka telefoonka ma ku dari kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Of course. I will add it under the address.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Cinwaanka hoostiisa ayaan ku dari doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Good. I can read it later.
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. Mar dambe waan akhriyi karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Here is the note.
dialogue.somali: Waa kan qoraalkii.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Thank you for your help.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay caawintaada.

title: Explaining Your English Level
situation: A learner explains their English level before joining a class and asks the teacher to use simple words.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa sharxaya heerkiisa Ingiriisiga ka hor inta uusan fasal ku biirin wuxuuna macallinka ka codsanayaa erayo fudud.
key_phrases: My English level is beginner.
I am still learning.
Please use simple words with me.
I understand better when I practice.
Then you can join the beginner class on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Hello. I want to join an English class.
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Waxaan rabaa inaan ku biiro fasal Ingiriisi ah.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Welcome. What is your English level?
dialogue.somali: Soo dhowow. Heerkaaga Ingiriisigu waa maxay?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: My English level is beginner.
dialogue.somali: Heerka Ingiriisigaygu waa bilow.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: That's fine. Are you learning reading or speaking first?
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa hagaag. Akhriska miyaad marka hore baranaysaa mise hadalka?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Speaking first. I am still learning.
dialogue.somali: Hadalka marka hore. Weli waan baranayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: No problem. The teacher will speak slowly.
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Macallinku si tartiib ah ayuu u hadli doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Please use simple words with me.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan erayo fudud ila isticmaal.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Of course. We also practice short conversations.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Waxaan sidoo kale ku tababbarannaa wada-sheekaysiyo gaagaaban.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Good. I understand better when I practice.
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. Si fiican ayaan u fahmaa marka aan tababarto.

dialogue.speaker: Staff member
dialogue.english: Then you can join the beginner class on Monday.
dialogue.somali: Markaa waxaad Isniinta ku biiri kartaa fasalka bilowga.
